title: Module 2 Quiz: Technical Analysis Deep Dive

questions.text: In a strong uptrend, an RSI reading above 70 always indicates an imminent price reversal.
questions.explanation: In a strong uptrend RSI can stay overbought for hours while price climbs, so never short just because RSI is high.

questions.text: What does high volume on a price breakout indicate?
options: The breakout is likely to fail due to lack of interest
The move lacks conviction and may reverse quickly
Strong market commitment behind the breakout, increasing its reliability
Volume is irrelevant to breakout validity
questions.explanation: High volume accompanying a breakout shows strong participation, supporting the validity of the move.

questions.text: How is an uptrend defined in technical analysis?
questions.explanation: An uptrend consists of higher highs and higher lows.

questions.text: What does price trading above the 200 EMA indicate for a trader?
options: Ignore the EMA as it is irrelevant
Switch to a lower timeframe for entries
questions.explanation: Price above the 200 EMA means the big‑picture trend is up, so only long trades are considered.
